title: Units a dose is given in
binding: a questionnaire question's `answer_value_set`, when the answer carries the concept
source: UCUM symbols, each confirmed through tx.fhir.org CodeSystem/$validate-code against the UCUM code system. Deliberately separate from duration-unit: one unit value set across both would let a dose be two weeks.
verified: every symbol confirmed against UCUM 2.2 through tx.fhir.org

mL.display_source: a label declared in scripts/seed_terminology.py; UCUM publishes no display, the symbol is the code
mL.verified: confirmed as a UCUM 2.2 symbol through tx.fhir.org CodeSystem/$validate-code
mL.why: Millilitre, how an oral liquid is measured.

mg.display_source: a label declared in scripts/seed_terminology.py; UCUM publishes no display, the symbol is the code
mg.verified: confirmed as a UCUM 2.2 symbol through tx.fhir.org CodeSystem/$validate-code
mg.why: Milligram, how a tablet strength is written.

{tablet}.display_source: a label declared in scripts/seed_terminology.py; UCUM publishes no display, the symbol is the code
{tablet}.verified: confirmed as a UCUM 2.2 symbol through tx.fhir.org CodeSystem/$validate-code
{tablet}.why: One tablet. A UCUM annotation, which is a real UCUM expression and not a free text escape: the braces are the grammar's own way of carrying a unit that has no dimension. A prescription written in tablets is how a health centre dispenses, and refusing it would push the count into a text box.
